blocks:article-grid.title: Article Grid
blocks:article-grid.description: A three-item editorial browse region with real image cards, one category, concise summaries, author and date context, and a plain latest-writing introduction.

blocks:release-highlight.title: Release Highlight
blocks:release-highlight.description: The complete changelog Block: one yellow Marker-led release thesis, a featured release note, and a visible-caption history table.

blocks:developer-changelog.title: Developer Changelog
blocks:developer-changelog.description: Technical changelog with code blocks showing API changes, migration examples, and usage snippets alongside release notes.

blocks:product-roadmap.title: Product Roadmap
blocks:product-roadmap.description: Hybrid roadmap and changelog with shipped, in-progress, and planned items. Includes status dots, tags, and optional feature images.

blocks:launch-countdown.title: Launch Countdown
blocks:launch-countdown.description: Coming soon section with a live countdown timer showing days, hours, minutes, and seconds until launch.

blocks:launch-roadmap.title: Launch Roadmap
blocks:launch-roadmap.description: Coming soon section with a vertical timeline showing launch phases, dates, and status indicators.

blocks:newsletter-signup.title: Newsletter Signup
blocks:newsletter-signup.description: The canonical newsletter capture: one monthly promise, one generic Email Capture Form, and one pink storyteller field without fake subscriber proof.

blocks:closing-cta.title: Closing CTA
blocks:closing-cta.description: A centered call to action with a Marker kicker, large heading, short paragraph, and one primary action with an outline alternative.

blocks:faq-with-support.title: FAQ with Support
blocks:faq-with-support.description: The considered-purchase FAQ: a familiar accordion beside one pink character and direct human support field, with one conversation action and no nested support card.

blocks:newsletter-footer.title: Newsletter Footer
blocks:newsletter-footer.description: The newsletter-specific footer: one Marker-led email capture, useful varunUI catalog routes, restrained social links, and plain brand metadata.

blocks:site-footer.title: Site Footer
blocks:site-footer.description: The one complete site footer: a Marker-led closing statement and primary action, plain catalog navigation, optional email, social links, and legal meta composed through the generic Footer Piece.

blocks:testimonial-hero.title: Testimonial Hero
blocks:testimonial-hero.description: A green character-led proof hero with one promise, one attributed result, and no more than two actions.

blocks:feature-hero.title: Feature Hero
blocks:feature-hero.description: The default character-led product hero: one marked promise, no more than two actions, and one local storyteller on a named pastel field.
